en.summary: Current probability of WTI Crude Oil falling is 98%, driven by expectations of US-Iran peace talks. Recent headlines indicate a reversal in oil prices due to potential increased supply.

en.title: Interest Rate Stability Expected
en.summary: The probability of no change in the Bank of Japan's interest rates has risen to 97%. This increase follows global trends of central banks, like the Bank of England and Bank Indonesia, maintaining their rates despite inflation concerns.
drivers: Bank of England holds rates amid inflation fears
Bank Indonesia keeps rates unchanged due to geopolitical risks
Global economic stability influences Japan's policy decisions
en.why_matters: Stable interest rates in Japan can support economic growth and investor confidence. It reflects a broader trend among central banks to prioritize stability.
en.bull_case: If global inflation pressures ease, the probability of unchanged rates could rise further.
en.bear_case: Unexpected inflation spikes could force the Bank of Japan to reconsider its current stance.
